highlights: Claude Code and Codex CLI panes now always receive a true-colour interactive terminal contract
fixes: Terminal panes remove inherited and provider-level colour suppression before launch, preventing monochrome agent TUIs
Interactive panes explicitly advertise xterm-256color and truecolour after provider launch overrides are applied
databaseChanges: No database schema changes; schema version remains 46
requiredManualActions: Stable 0.4.22 and later download and install this signed update automatically at the next safe restart. Stable 0.4.21 requires the one-time 0.4.22 bootstrap approval because that older binary cannot install an update without user action.
